english.title: Enter / attempt to enter premises for purpose of attending football match without valid ticket

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1A and 5 of the Football (Offences) Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
entered / attempted to enter premises

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: There are two defences for this offence contained within section 1A(2) and (3). Subsection (2) provides a defence if the individual had lawful authority or lawful excuse for entering, or attempting to enter, the premises. Subsection (3) provides a defence for the individual to show they entered through a normal entry route for spectators and at the time of entry they reasonably believed they held a valid ticket for the match when they, in fact, did not.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.

The court must make a banning order under the Football Spectators Act 1989 where a person is convicted of this offence unless there are particular circumstances not to do so (this offence is listed as a relevant offence in Schedule 1).
